settings_updates_whats_new_badge_install.description: Badge on the release header of the What's new sheet: this is the version that runs now. The subject is a release (feminine in Portuguese), unlike the channel tag of Settings.
settings_updates_whats_new_badge_install.distinct: A release badge (feminine in Portuguese); the channel selector tag with the same English word is a different key.

settings_updates_whats_new_badge_latest: Badge on the release header of the What's new sheet: this is the newest release the channel offers.

settings_updates_whats_new_badge_new.description: Badge on the release header of the What's new sheet right after an update: this is the version just installed.
settings_updates_whats_new_badge_new.distinct: A release badge (feminine in Portuguese, Nova); the chat divider with the same English word is another thing.

settings_updates_whats_new_collapse_aria: Accessible name of the button that folds one release's notes in the What's new sheet. {version} is the release version.
settings_updates_whats_new_dev_note: Hint in the footer of the What's new sheet when the app is a dev build and an update is on offer.
settings_updates_whats_new_download_prog: Progress line under the download bar of the install footer. {percent} is a whole number 0 to 100, {total} the size of the download as text (12.4 MB).
settings_updates_whats_new_download_unkn: Progress line under the download bar of the install footer while the download size is not known yet.
settings_updates_whats_new_empty_body: Body of the empty state of the What's new sheet: the changelog has no section for the version named in the title.
settings_updates_whats_new_empty_title: Title of the empty state of the What's new sheet. {version} is the version the sheet asked notes for.
settings_updates_whats_new_empty_title_u: Title of the empty state of the What's new sheet when the version asked for is not known.
settings_updates_whats_new_expand_aria: Accessible name of the button that unfolds one release's notes in the What's new sheet. {version} is the release version.

settings_updates_whats_new_fold_less.description: Button that folds a long change description back, in the What's new sheet.
settings_updates_whats_new_fold_less.distinct: Folds one change entry of a release note; the other Less keys are setup output and shortcut groups.

settings_updates_whats_new_fold_more.description: Button that unfolds a long change description, in the What's new sheet.
settings_updates_whats_new_fold_more.distinct: Unfolds one change entry of a release note; the shortcut group named More is another thing.

settings_updates_whats_new_following: Footer line of the What's new sheet: the channel the shown release was cut for, then the channel the app follows. {#chip} wraps {channel} (a styled badge) and {#b} wraps {followed}; both are channel display names (Stable, Beta, Alpha).
settings_updates_whats_new_host_terminal: Sentence in the failed-update footer when the terminal host is stale and terminals still run, so it was not restarted. {count} is the number of running terminals; zero is not shown but required.
settings_updates_whats_new_install_now: Primary button of the What's new sheet for a package-managed install the app may run. {version} is the release version.
settings_updates_whats_new_kind_added: Group heading of release notes for the kind `added` (Keep a Changelog: Added, also New).
settings_updates_whats_new_kind_changed: Group heading of release notes for the kind `changed` (Keep a Changelog: Changed, also Improved).
settings_updates_whats_new_kind_deprecat: Group heading of release notes for the kind `deprecated`.
settings_updates_whats_new_kind_fixed: Group heading of release notes for the kind `fixed`.

settings_updates_whats_new_kind_removed.description: Group heading of release notes for the kind `removed`.
settings_updates_whats_new_kind_removed.distinct: A changelog group heading (Removido); the SSH host status with the same English word is another thing.

settings_updates_whats_new_kind_security: Group heading of release notes for the kind `security`.
settings_updates_whats_new_load_failed: Title of the error state of the What's new sheet when the release notes could not be loaded; the reason and a Retry button follow.
settings_updates_whats_new_loading_aria: Accessible name of the loading placeholder of the What's new sheet.
settings_updates_whats_new_managed_or_at: Hint under the command of a package-managed install when the app can run it: the system asks for the user's password.
settings_updates_whats_new_managed_run: Hint above the command of a package-managed install. {title} is the translated managed-by title; the command follows in its own box.
settings_updates_whats_new_no_changes: Shown under a release header whose notes list no changes.
settings_updates_whats_new_open_changelo: Button of the empty state of the What's new sheet that opens the website's changelog.
settings_updates_whats_new_open_github_a: Accessible name of the icon button that opens one release's GitHub page. {version} is the release version.
settings_updates_whats_new_pre_rc: Badge on a release header for a release candidate. RC stays as is in every language.
settings_updates_whats_new_region_aria: Accessible name of the scrolling list of release notes in the What's new sheet.
settings_updates_whats_new_relaunch: Button of the What's new sheet after an install: quits and reopens the app on the new version.
settings_updates_whats_new_remind_later: Link in the What's new footer that closes the sheet and keeps the update on offer.
settings_updates_whats_new_review: Button next to the stale terminal host warning of the install footer; opens the restart prompt.
settings_updates_whats_new_rollback_fail: Failed-update message when the CLI could not be put back. {#code} wraps the command to run, kept verbatim.
settings_updates_whats_new_rollback_rest: Failed-update message when the CLI was put back after the app could not be updated. {version} is the CLI version it stays on.
Failed-update message when the CLI was put back and its version could not be read.
settings_updates_whats_new_skip_version: Link in the What's new footer: Atlas will not remind about this version again.
settings_updates_whats_new_update_failed: Failed-update message in the install footer when the CLI gave no reason.
settings_updates_whats_new_update_relaun: Primary button of the What's new sheet that installs the update and reopens the app. {version} is the release version.
Same button as the update and relaunch one when the download size is known. {version} is the release version, {size} the size as text (12.4 MB).
settings_updates_whats_new_versions_aria: Accessible name of the sticky version index at the top of the What's new sheet.
settings_updates_whats_new_view_github: Link in the What's new footer to the GitHub page of the shown release.
